assistant_text:
Here are the latest news articles related to robotics:

1. **[US: Donald Trump administration bans new humanoid robot imports from China](https://interestingengineering.com/ai-robotics/us-ban-china-humanoid-robot-quadrupeds)**  
   The FCC has added humanoid robots and quadrupeds to its Covered List due to US security concerns. This ban also includes connected power inverters used in renewable energy and data centers.

2. **[US bans foreign-made humanoid robots, targeting China](https://abcnews.com/Business/wireStory/us-bans-foreign-made-humanoid-robots-targeting-china-135179676)**  
   The Pentagon has placed Chinese robot maker Unitree on its list of firms with ties to the Chinese military, leading to a ban on imports of humanoid robots and quadrupeds from China.

3. **[US bans foreign-made humanoid robots, targeting China over national security](https://apnews.com/article/china-us-humanoid-robots-ban-tech-c9f5e3c94d91d00eff3b61b141fab366)**  
   The ban is part of a broader effort to safeguard US technology and industries amid rising competition with China, which dominates the humanoid robot market.

4. **[China’s humanoid robots have been taking over the global market. Now the US is banning them](https://www.cnn.com/2026/07/29/tech/us-china-robot-ban-intl-hnk)**  
   The new restrictions aim to protect domestic industries and supply chains as the rivalry with China intensifies in advanced technology and AI.

5. **[NY teachers push for AI safeguards after district halts AI robot plan](https://www.lohud.com/story/news/ny-news/2026/07/29/nysut-pushes-for-ai-safeguards-after-school-district-pauses-ai-robot/91068281007)**  
   A union representing New York educators is advocating for safeguards against the use of AI in schools after a district paused a pilot program involving a humanoid robot in classrooms.

If you need more information or specific details about any of these articles, feel free to ask!

items.title: NY teachers push for AI safeguards after district halts AI robot plan
items.summary:
# NY teachers push for AI safeguards after district halts AI robot plan

Portrait of Emily Barnes

A union representing New York educators is calling for statewide safeguards against the use of artificial intelligence in schools after a district announced their involvement in a pilot program that includes a humanoid robot's presence in a classroom.
